# Estate Plan Design Meeting — Checklist

<!-- Generated by `npm run design:forms`. Edit lib/designMeeting/formSpec.ts, not this file. -->

The order to work through a design meeting, and what each section has to come away with.
Pair it with `design-meeting-worksheet.docx`, which carries the same sections in the same
order and is what gets uploaded afterwards.

## Before the meeting

- [ ] Open the matter at `/admin/drafting/<matterId>` so the design sheet is seeded.
- [ ] Note the number on the **Complete sheet** button — that is what still blocks drafting.
- [ ] Run **Complete sheet → Fill what is missing** and accept what intake already supports,
      so the meeting is spent on decisions rather than on data entry.
- [ ] Print the worksheet, or open it alongside the sheet.

## During the meeting

### 1. Client & Spouse

Confirm what intake already captured. Correct anything that has changed.

- [ ] Client name
- [ ] Client date of birth
- [ ] Client AKA
- [ ] Marital status — single / married / divorced / widowed / separated / domestic_partner
- [ ] Spouse name
- [ ] Spouse date of birth
- [ ] Spouse AKA
- [ ] Marriage date
- [ ] Street
- [ ] City
- [ ] State
- [ ] ZIP
- [ ] County — Barnstable / Berkshire / Bristol / Dukes / Essex / Franklin / Hampden / Hampshire / Middlesex / Nantucket / Norfolk / Plymouth / Suffolk / Worcester

### 2. Family & Guardians

Children by full legal name. Guardians matter only where a child is a minor.

- [ ] Excluded guardian
- [ ] Excluded guardian name
- [ ] Children (full legal name, date of birth, minor or adult)
- [ ] Anyone deliberately left out, and why

### 3. Plan Type

The shape of the plan. Everything downstream follows from this.

- [ ] Plan type — pour_over / outright_will / testamentary_trust
- [ ] Joint plan
- [ ] Trust name
- [ ] Spouse trust name
- [ ] Restatement

### 4. Fiduciaries

Full legal names, and relationship where it is not obvious.

- [ ] PR same as trustee
- [ ] DPOA same as trustee
- [ ] Trustee — primary
- [ ] Trustee — alternate
- [ ] Trustee — second alternate
- [ ] Personal representative — primary
- [ ] Personal representative — alternate
- [ ] Attorney-in-fact (financial POA) — primary
- [ ] Attorney-in-fact (financial POA) — alternate
- [ ] Health care agent — primary
- [ ] Health care agent — alternate
- [ ] Guardian for minor children — primary
- [ ] Guardian for minor children — alternate

### 5. Distribution

How and when the residuary reaches the beneficiaries.

- [ ] Residual beneficiary method — outright / staggered / trust_for_life / custom
- [ ] Residuary after death — descendants_outright_per_stirpes / descendants_shares_outright_children_trusts_others / descendants_shares_all_trusts / named_beneficiaries_separate_terms
- [ ] Representation type — by_representation / per_stirpes / per_capita_each_generation
- [ ] Distribution age
- [ ] First stagger age
- [ ] First stagger percentage
- [ ] Second stagger age
- [ ] Second stagger percentage
- [ ] Final stagger age
- [ ] Remote beneficiary — heirs_at_law / half_heirs_spouse / named
- [ ] Tangible property distribution

### 6. Will Provisions

Standing choices. Most matters take the firm default unless the client raises something.

- [ ] Bond — no_bond / required
- [ ] Supervision — unsupervised / supervised
- [ ] No-contest clause — omit / include
- [ ] UTMA age
- [ ] Simultaneous death — spouse_survives / testator_survives / omit
- [ ] Pet care option — omit / direct_bequest / pet_trust
- [ ] Specific bequests (who receives what, and from the will or the trust)

### 7. Health Care

The client’s own elections. Never presumed from the firm’s standards.

- [ ] Client advance directive — prolong_life / do_not_resuscitate / do_not_prolong_life
- [ ] Client anatomical gift — yes / defer / no
- [ ] Spouse advance directive — prolong_life / do_not_resuscitate / do_not_prolong_life
- [ ] Spouse anatomical gift — yes / defer / no

### 8. Signing & Notes

Close the meeting here. Anything unresolved belongs in concerns, not in a guess.

- [ ] Goals notes
- [ ] Concerns
- [ ] Drafting notes
- [ ] Signing county (defaults to Norfolk — Needham office)
- [ ] Target signing date

## After the meeting

- [ ] Upload the worksheet: **Complete sheet → Word document → Read document**.
- [ ] Review the proposed rows. Anything in the **rejected** panel is a value the field
      cannot hold — set it on the sheet directly rather than rewording the worksheet.
- [ ] Check the **People** group before accepting: a row badged *Creates a new contact*
      will mint a contact record, so confirm it is not someone already on the matter under
      a different spelling.
- [ ] Accept, then confirm the **Complete sheet** count dropped.
- [ ] Anything left undecided stays a client question — it belongs in Concerns, not in a
      value nobody chose.
